summary: Attribute runtime stops and work-scope teardown with structured boundary evidence

replay.detail: Logging only; existing teardown and reconciliation decisions are unchanged.

schema.detail: No registry, claim or storage schema change.

rules.detail: Destructive runtime boundaries log their caller, reason, identity evidence and guard outcome before acting; skipped teardown decisions log at debug level.

compatibility.detail: No runtime control API or lifecycle behavior change. Unavailable identity fields remain absent rather than implying proof.

downtime.detail: Updated processes emit the additional tracing evidence without a migration.

manual.detail: Use info-level teardown events to attribute stops and scope signals; enable debug logging to inspect guard skips.

recovery.detail: Existing incarnation fences, scope guards, shutdown grace periods and recovery behavior are unchanged.
